item.title: Custom software, specialized workflows, and other new growth paths from SaaS Platform Summit
item.description: SaaS platforms have long built for specific verticals Now AI makes it practical to build for one merchant At Stripe’s SaaS Platform Summit, founders and operators shared how custom software and embedded finance can open new revenue streams.
